correctness.rationale: PASS: Direct coefficient integration yields T_g=DM_h with D diagonal 1/log n, and the finite Bohr lift of -g′ gives ||M_h||=C_g. Truncating N input coordinates proves s_(N+1)<=C_g/log(2N+2). Coprime prime-free fibers of a fixed finite polynomial near norm extremizer give positive-density orthogonal inputs and orthogonal images with lower norms (C_g-o(1))/log N. Min-max proves (log n)s_n→C_g; monotone inversion yields t log N_g(t)→C_g. The one-frequency exact sequence and infinite Schatten divergence agree with the coefficient law. Independent monomial and two-prime normalization checks passed. All asymptotic steps rely on proof, not finite experiments.
